create_solver_ate_regmatch: create an ATE exploitability regret matching solver with configurable Tsallis entropy parameter p
init_solver_vars: initialize solver variables including distributions, auxiliary variables, and cumulative gradients for each player
compute_gradients_ate: compute exploitability gradients and Tsallis entropy regularized gradients for nonsymmetric games
update_solver_params: update solver parameters via projected gradient descent with regret matching and optional optimism
calculate_ate_exploitability: calculate Tsallis entropy regularized exploitability for a given strategy distribution
